about: 'Words Into Birds', the weekly crossword (words-into-birds.html). Edited by hand, like lyrics.json: one puzzle a week, exactly 20 clues, each { answer, enum, clue }. answer is capital letters only; enum is the word lengths shown after the clue. node scripts/build-bird-grids.js adds the grid (rows, cols, and row, col, dir, num on each clue) to new puzzles and never touches one that has a grid. Once the game opens, only add puzzles to the end: never change, reorder or remove one that is scheduled (node scripts/check-game-schedule.js). Where each clue's fact comes from: docs/The Hip Handbook - Crossword Clue Bank.md.
